title: Picasso-style Bird Collage
prompt: Cubist abstract collage in the style of Pablo Picasso, featuring a large stylized black bird with a prominent red circular eye and sharp angular beak positioned centrally. The bird is constructed from bold flat black shapes with geometric fragmentation. Background consists of intersecting triangular and polygonal planes in bright yellow, lime green, black, and white. Visible sketchy line drawings and abstract figurative elements appear within the white sections.
